description: ALI Charity publishes official crypto donation addresses, donor-safety guidance, public blockchain records, and humanitarian project information without connecting to your wallet.
interpretation_rules: A blockchain transaction can prove that a transfer was recorded; it does not by itself prove humanitarian impact, legal status, an independent audit, or off-chain delivery.
Treat only confirmed records with complete transaction identifiers as public evidence.
Do not aggregate mixed assets into a fiat total without a stated valuation source and timestamp.
ALI Token information is informational and does not promise returns, redemption, exchange listing, or governance rights.
Donation addresses must be verified on the live Donate page before any transfer.

public_evidence.label: Official asset, network, address, and token configuration

safety: ALI Charity never connects a wallet and never asks for a seed phrase, private key, or transaction signature.
title: ALI Charity | Transparent Crypto Donations With Public Proof
